architecture_contract.method: Bayesian multi-view factor analysis with per-sample latent factors Z, per-view feature weights W, view-specific likelihoods, optional sparsity/ARD, and optional MEFISTO Gaussian-process factors
architecture_contract.missing_data: NaN entries are masked in the likelihood and replaced internally by zero only after a separate mask is recorded.
architecture_contract.inductive_limitation: Ordinary MOFA factors are free variational parameters for the samples included during model fitting; there is no amortized encoder or official frozen factor transform for a new assay vector.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No upstream checkpoint exists. A local fitted HDF5 object would be development-only and cannot be used for sealed-query refitting.

inductive_inference_contract.ordinary_mofa: No champion-eligible unseen-sample transform exists. Adding held RNA rows with ATAC set to NaN and refitting or optimizing their Z values is transductive and prohibited.
inductive_inference_contract.mefisto_limit: predict_factor predicts Z at new covariate coordinates from a fitted Gaussian-process prior. It does not infer factors from a new donor's RNA assay and is not an RNA query transform.
inductive_inference_contract.imputation_limit: entry_point.impute reconstructs missing entries for samples already represented by fitted Z. It cannot produce an inductive ATAC profile for a new RNA-only donor without fitting that donor's latent variables.
inductive_inference_contract.allowed_use: Development-only factor interpretation on outer-training samples under a separate nonpromotable TaskSpec.

input_contract.assays: nested sample-by-feature matrices or a long dataframe; each view has a declared gaussian, bernoulli, or poisson likelihood
input_contract.pairing: Views share a common sample axis. Entire missing views can be represented by NaN, but unrelated cells or aliquots must not be asserted as the same biological observation.
input_contract.preprocessing: Centering by group is default; view/group scaling is optional. All centering, scaling, likelihood choice, feature selection, and factor count selection must be outer-training-only.
input_contract.reference: GENCODE v49 gene names and GRCh38.p14 peak identifiers with modality namespaces and frozen feature order

missingness_contract.native: Entrywise NaN is recorded in a mask and excluded from updates and likelihood calculations. This supports structurally absent views for fitted samples.
missingness_contract.project_mapping: MOFA stores only observed versus masked. Preserve the eight project missingness reasons outside the model and use NaN plus mask, never semantic zero.
missingness_contract.sealed_rule: Native missing-view support does not make the model inductive; a sealed donor cannot be inserted as a masked training sample.

output_contract.development_embedding: fitted-sample factor expectation Z with factor sign/order and training sample IDs frozen
output_contract.imputation: WZ reconstruction for missing entries of fitted samples only
output_contract.not_admitted: training-sample imputation, MEFISTO covariate prediction, or refitted query factors cannot enter RNA-conditioned ATAC or sealed cell-state leaderboards

safe_loading_contract.required_artifacts: Immutable project-fitted HDF5 plus plain manifests for W, Z, intercepts, masks, feature/sample orders, likelihoods, transforms, factor ordering, seed, environment, and hashes.

source_evidence: The exact 0.7.4 release commit, LGPL-3.0 license, public PyPI JSON metadata, and relevant source files were inspected as text on 2026-08-22. Distributions, packages, fitted models, and data were not downloaded, installed, deserialized, or executed.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Deferred and ineligible for sealed mapping because no frozen unseen-sample transform exists.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Ineligible and latent-only; imputation reconstructs missing views only for samples whose Z was fitted.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible because MOFA+ has no DNA sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
